messages:
maria: Heads up — main turned red right after my merge (PR #4178). CI failed in `compile-kernels` with a hard timeout (30m). Build: https://ci/repo/builds/8421 :anguished:

infra-bot: Build #8421 — job `compile-kernels` timed out after 00:30:00. Logs: https://ci/repo/builds/8421/logs/compile-kernels

devin: :eyes: pinging owners. last green was commit 73f2b3a. @alex do you own the kernels step?

sara: I can pick this up. quick question — can we rerun just that job? If it's transient we can avoid a full bisect.

maria: retrying single job now with `./tools/ci retry --job compile-kernels --build 8421`

infra-bot: Rerun queued for Build 8421 — job compile-kernels (retry 1). https://ci/repo/builds/8421/retry

devin: if rerun passes we should still note it, but if it fails again we should bisect — could be env or image change.

sara: rerun finished — failed again with the same timeout. pasting tail of the log: ```
[2025-03-10T14:12:03Z] INFO Starting kernel build
[2025-03-10T14:42:03Z] ERROR timeout after 1800s while waiting for apt-get to fetch dependencies
[2025-03-10T14:42:03Z] ERROR job terminated
```

chris: quick check: did the merge change base images or any container tags? @maria

maria: yeah I bumped the base-image in the Dockerfile from `redwood/base:2025-02-10` -> `redwood/base:2025-02-12` to pick up a security patch. Could be related.

devin: ok that narrows it. apt/mirror timeouts could come from the new image using a different mirror or network config. Can someone try a local reproduce: `CI_LOCAL=1 ./scripts/build_kernels.sh --no-cache`

sara: starting a git bisect against main to confirm. if bisect points to the image bump we can revert.

maria: confirming — that was my commit. happy to open a revert if bisect confirms.

oncall-bot: @sara is oncall for eng-infra until 18:00 UTC.

sara: bisect result: `git bisect` points to commit 73f2b3a (the base-image bump). reproduction: `docker run --rm redwood/base:2025-02-12 sh -c "apt-get update || exit 1"` returns intermittent timeouts within our CI network.

devin: sounds like the new base image changed apt sources or DNS settings. Two immediate actions: (1) revert the base-image bump on main (canary branch) and (2) add a fallback apt mirror and image-digest pinning as a follow-up.

maria: opened revert PR #4180 and kicked off its CI: https://ci/repo/builds/4180

infra-bot: Build 4180 started — full pipeline.

sara: monitoring 4180. if that passes we can merge revert and unblock main.

devin: filing INFRA-1234 to track durable fix (image-digest pinning + apt fallback + mirror health check).

chris: if revert passes, let's merge revert + then a small patch that pins digest and adds apt mirror fallback before re-landing the original change.

maria: thanks all — I'll follow up on the revert and the follow-up ticket. Sorry for the churn :heart:

sara: 4180 just went green. promoting and will merge in 2m.

infra-bot: Build 4180 succeeded. Main pipeline status: green.

devin: great catch and quick triage team. We'll keep INFRA-1234 open until the follow-ups land.

maria: will open PRs for digest pinning and mirror fallback today.

chris: closing loop here. lessons: be cautious with base-image bumps during high-traffic hours and consider staged rollout. :thumbsup:
